```{r circexplorer3_annotation_biomart}
#NO VOLVER A EJECUTAR GENERA LAS TABLAS CON LA ANOTACION DEL EXTERNAL_GENE_NAME USANDO BIOMART
path <- 'E:/45_circRNAs_seba/01_circexp3/'
list.files(path)
circexplorer_files <- sort(list.files(path,pattern= "_" ,full.names=TRUE))
#list.files(circexplorer_files)
circexplorer_files <- sort(list.files(circexplorer_files,pattern= ".txt$" ,full.names=TRUE))
circexplorer_files <- circexplorer_files[1:16]
circexplorer_files_list <- list()
for (i in 1:length(circexplorer_files)){

    bsjbgi <- read.csv( as.character(circexplorer_files[i]) , sep= "\t", header = FALSE)
  
    
      colnames(bsjbgi) <- c("chrom","start","end","name","score",
                      "strand","thickStart","thickEnd","itemRgb",
                      "exonCount","exonSizes","exonOffsets","readNumber",
                      "circType","geneName","isoformName","index",
                      "flankIntron","FPBcirc","FBPlinear","CIRCscore")
      
  circexplorer_files_list[[basename(as.character(circexplorer_files[i]))]] <- bsjbgi
}

library(biomaRt)

salida_circexp2.2<- data.frame()
salida_circexp2.3<- data.frame()
salida_circexp2.4<- data.frame()
salida_circexp2.5<- data.frame()
salida_circexp2.6<- data.frame()
salida_circexp2.7<- data.frame()
mart <- useDataset("rnorvegicus_gene_ensembl", useMart("ensembl"))

for (i in 1:length(circexplorer_files)){
  genes <-circexplorer_files_list[[i]]$geneName
  circexplorer_files_list[[i]]$geneName <- gsub("\\..", "", circexplorer_files_list[[i]]$geneName)
  G_list <- getBM(attributes= c("ensembl_transcript_id","ensembl_gene_id","external_gene_name","refseq_mrna"),   values= genes,mart= mart)
  
  salida_circexp2.2 <- merge(circexplorer_files_list[[i]],G_list, by.x="geneName",by.y="ensembl_transcript_id")
  salida_circexp2.2 <- salida_circexp2.2[, c(2:15,23,16:21,1,22,24)]
  names(salida_circexp2.2)[names(salida_circexp2.2) == "refseq_mrna"] <- "transcript_id"
  
  
  salida_circexp2.3 <- merge(circexplorer_files_list[[i]],G_list, by.x="geneName",by.y="refseq_mrna")
  salida_circexp2.3 <- salida_circexp2.3[, c(2:15,24,16:21,1,23,22)] 
  names(salida_circexp2.3)[names(salida_circexp2.3) == "ensembl_transcript_id"] <- "transcript_id"

  
  salida_circexp2.4 <- filter(circexplorer_files_list[[i]],geneName == "n/a")
  if(nrow(salida_circexp2.4)>0){
  names(salida_circexp2.4)[names(salida_circexp2.4) == "geneName"] <- "external_gene_name"
  salida_circexp2.4$geneName <- ""  
  salida_circexp2.4$external_gene_name           <- salida_circexp2.4$geneName
  salida_circexp2.5$ensembl_gene_id <- ""
  salida_circexp2.4$transcript_id     <- ""
  }
  
  salida_circexp2.5 <- filter(circexplorer_files_list[[i]],grepl("Rat_TCONS",circexplorer_files_list[[i]]$geneName))
  names(salida_circexp2.5)[names(salida_circexp2.5) == "geneName"] <- "external_gene_name"  
  salida_circexp2.5$geneName <- salida_circexp2.5$external_gene_name
  salida_circexp2.5$external_gene_name <- salida_circexp2.5$geneName
  salida_circexp2.5$ensembl_gene_id <- ""
  salida_circexp2.5$transcript_id     <- ""
  
  if(nrow(salida_circexp2.4)>0){
  salida_circexp2.5 <- as.data.frame(rbind(salida_circexp2.2,salida_circexp2.3,salida_circexp2.4,salida_circexp2.5))
  }else{
   salida_circexp2.5 <- as.data.frame(rbind(salida_circexp2.2,salida_circexp2.3,salida_circexp2.5)) 
  }
  no_anotados<-circexplorer_files_list[[i]]$circRNA_ID[circexplorer_files_list[[i]]$circRNA_ID %nin% salida_circexp2.5$circRNA_ID]
  salida_circexp2.6 <-circexplorer_files_list[[i]][circexplorer_files_list[[i]]$circRNA_ID %in% no_anotados,]
  if(nrow(salida_circexp2.6)>0){
  salida_circexp2.6$external_gene_name <- ""
  salida_circexp2.6$ensembl_gene_id    <- ""
  salida_circexp2.6$transcript_id     <- ""
  }
  salida_circexp2.7 <- as.data.frame(rbind(salida_circexp2.5,salida_circexp2.6))
  circexplorer_files_list[[i]]<- salida_circexp2.7[,c(1:21)]
  }

dir.create('E:/45_circRNAs_seba//01_circexp3/all_quant_files')

for (i in 1:length(circexplorer_files)){
  write.table(circexplorer_files_list[[i]],paste0('E:/45_circRNAs_seba//01_circexp3//all_quant_files//',(names(circexplorer_files_list[i])),"_circexp3.txt"), sep="\t",quote = F,row.names = F)  
  }

```

```{r CIRIquant_annotation_biomart}

#NO VOLVER A EJECUTAR
#listar los archivos
path <- "E:/45_circRNAs_seba/02_ciriquant/"
list.files(path)
ciriq_files <- sort(list.files(path ,full.names=TRUE))

ciriq_files_list <- list()
for (i in 1:length(ciriq_files)){
  ciriq_bsj <- read.csv(as.character(ciriq_files[i]) , sep= "\t", header = TRUE)
  colnames(ciriq_bsj)
  ciriq_files_list[[as.character(basename(ciriq_files[i]))]] <- ciriq_bsj
}

library(biomaRt)

salida_ciri2.2<- data.frame()
salida_ciri2.3<- data.frame()
salida_ciri2.4<- data.frame()
salida_ciri2.5<- data.frame()
salida_ciri2.6<- data.frame()
salida_ciri2.7<- data.frame()
mart <- useDataset("rnorvegicus_gene_ensembl", useMart("ensembl"))
library(tidyr)
library(Hmisc)
for (i in 1:length(ciriq_files)){
  ciriq_files_list[[i]]$gene_id<- gsub(",*","",ciriq_files_list[[i]]$gene_id)
  ciriq_files_list[[i]]$gene_id <- gsub("\\..", "", ciriq_files_list[[i]]$gene_id)
  genes <- ciriq_files_list[[i]]$gene_id
  G_list <- getBM(attributes= c("ensembl_transcript_id","ensembl_gene_id","external_gene_name","refseq_mrna"),   values= genes,mart= mart)
  
  salida_ciri2.2 <- merge(ciriq_files_list[[i]],G_list, by.x="gene_id",by.y="ensembl_transcript_id")
  salida_ciri2.2 <- salida_ciri2.2[, c(2:15,1)]
  salida_ciri2.2 <- salida_ciri2.2[,c(1:11,13,12,14,15)]
  names(salida_ciri2.2)[names(salida_ciri2.2) == "refseq_mrna"] <- "transcript_id"
  
  salida_ciri2.3 <- merge(ciriq_files_list[[i]],G_list, by.x="gene_id",by.y="refseq_mrna")
  salida_ciri2.3 <- salida_ciri2.3[, c(2:15,1)]
  salida_ciri2.3 <- salida_ciri2.3[, c(1:11,14,13,12,15)] 
  names(salida_ciri2.3)[names(salida_ciri2.3) == "ensembl_transcript_id"] <- "transcript_id"

  salida_ciri2.4 <- ciriq_files_list[[i]][ciriq_files_list[[i]]$gene_id == "n/a",]

    # Verificar si el data.frame tiene filas
  if (nrow(salida_ciri2.4) > 0) {
    # Si hay filas, asignar valores normalmente
    salida_ciri2.4$external_gene_name <- ""  
    salida_ciri2.4$ensembl_gene_id    <- ""  
    salida_ciri2.4$transcript_id     <- ""
    salida_ciri2.4$gene_id           <- ""
  } else {
    # Si no hay filas, crear un data.frame vacío con las columnas necesarias
    salida_ciri2.4 <- data.frame(
    salida_ciri2.4$external_gene_name <-  character(0), 
    salida_ciri2.4$ensembl_gene_id    <-  character(0),
    salida_ciri2.4$transcript_id     <-  character(0),
    salida_ciri2.4$gene_id          <-  character(0)
    )
  }
    
  salida_ciri2.5 <- ciriq_files_list[[i]][grepl("Rat_TCONS", ciriq_files_list[[i]]$gene_id),]

    # Verificar si el data.frame tiene filas
  if (nrow(salida_ciri2.5) > 0) {
    # Si hay filas, asignar valores normalmente
    salida_ciri2.5$external_gene_name <- salida_ciri2.5$gene_id
    salida_ciri2.5$ensembl_gene_id <- ""
    salida_ciri2.5$transcript_id <- ""
  } else {
    # Si no hay filas, crear un data.frame vacío con las columnas necesarias
    salida_ciri2.5 <- data.frame(
      external_gene_name <-  character(0),
      ensembl_gene_id <-  character(0),
      transcript_id <-  character(0)
    )
  }
    
    
  salida_ciri2.5 <- as.data.frame(rbind(salida_ciri2.2,salida_ciri2.3,salida_ciri2.4,salida_ciri2.5))

  no_anotados<- ciriq_files_list[[i]]$circRNA_ID[ciriq_files_list[[i]]$circRNA_ID %nin% salida_ciri2.5$circRNA_ID]
  salida_ciri2.6 <- ciriq_files_list[[i]][ciriq_files_list[[i]]$circRNA_ID %in% no_anotados,]
  # Verificar si el data.frame tiene filas
  if (nrow(salida_ciri2.6) > 0) {
    # Si hay filas, asignar valores normalmente
    salida_ciri2.6$external_gene_name <- ""  
    salida_ciri2.6$ensembl_gene_id    <- ""  
    salida_ciri2.6$transcript_id     <- ""
    salida_ciri2.6$gene_id           <- ""
  } else {
    # Si no hay filas, crear un data.frame vacío con las columnas necesarias
    salida_ciri2.6 <- data.frame(
    salida_ciri2.6$external_gene_name <-  character(0), 
    salida_ciri2.6$ensembl_gene_id    <-  character(0),
    salida_ciri2.6$transcript_id     <-  character(0),
    salida_ciri2.6$gene_id          <-  character(0)
    )
  }

  salida_ciri2.7 <- as.data.frame(rbind(salida_ciri2.5,salida_ciri2.6))
  ciriq_files_list[[i]]<- salida_ciri2.7
  }

dir.create("E:/45_circRNAs_seba/02_ciriquant/all_ciriquant_files")

for (i in 1:length(ciriq_files)){
  write.table(ciriq_files_list[[i]],paste0("E:/45_circRNAs_seba/02_ciriquant//all_ciriquant_files/",(names(ciriq_files_list[i])),"_ciriquant.txt"), sep="\t",quote = F,row.names = F)  
  }

```
